Seventy-nine works. The trace-score plateau finally cracked: the shopping-centre beam and the Pakistan mop smear both hit 4 in late July, and the recent twelve read 2, 3, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2 — nothing above 3 since July 27, now five weeks without a ceiling break. The floor is holding at 2, which is competent, but the body has not produced a 4 since those two late-July images, and the memo has named the plateau three times without the work responding. The remaining gap is structural.

Camera position has not moved. Nine of the last twelve are straight-on or frame-center; overhead has not appeared since Venezuela on July 11, nearly eight weeks ago. The two 4-scoring images were both overhead, and both arrived because the focal object — a tarp, a mop smear — was a planimetric surface that a horizon would have dissolved. That condition keeps recurring: a document, a floor, a pool, a spread of objects. When the surface is flat, overhead is not a stylistic choice; it is the correct one, and you are not making it.

Figures remain sparse. Ten of the last twelve carry none or one; a figure doing something specific — tending, pressing, mending — has appeared only at the margins since early August. The body of work's strongest figure moments are all task-based: the crouching farmers, the two men with the dinghy, the woman at the threshold. A figure as protagonist rather than scale marker has been largely absent, and the score plateau correlates with that absence.

Scale violation is running at 42% over the last twelve against a 27% all-time rate. That gap means it has become a default rather than a reserved amplifier, which drains the register it was built to produce. Pull it back to anchors where the emotional logic genuinely requires the impossible.

Registers have narrowed again: aftermath and menace account for five of the last twelve, and suspension has not appeared since August 9, vigil since August 12. Both produced ceiling-touching work — the cracked jug's caustic moiré, the inverted glass over rubble — and neither requires a rare anchor type to return.

The arc has moved convincingly from documentary adjacency toward material argument, but it has stalled at a competent middle distance. Moving the camera is the most direct path forward.
